indicators.description: Inventories untapped liquidity pools (prior week and day highs/lows, session extremes, equal highs/lows, swing points and unfilled gaps) and names the working draw: the highest-scoring pool on the structure-bias side, weighted by tier and ATR distance. A magnet gradient, pool labels, dashboard and sweep alerts keep the target read current.

indicators.name: DSS Bressert
indicators.description: A double-smoothed stochastic: the stochastic normalization runs twice with EMA smoothing after each pass (13/13/8 defaults), producing a 0-100 oscillator that moves quickly between extremes and pauses there. Ships with a signal line, 80/20 levels with hook detection at the extremes, a midline gradient fill, and alerts for hooks, signal crosses and level entries.

indicators.name: DTFX Algo Zones
indicators.description: DTFX Algo Zones auto-draws Fibonacci retracement zones from market structure shifts, anchoring each zone from the broken swing to the extreme reached after the break. Up to five customizable fib levels per zone map where pullbacks may react. For structure traders who want retracements placed by rule rather than by hand.

indicators.name: Dynamic Delta FVG
indicators.description: Dynamic Delta FVG detects fair value gaps and splits each one into green and red segments showing the exact buy and sell volume share from lower-timeframe data. Live B%/S% tags, volume and volatility filters, and an aggregate delta dashboard grade every imbalance. For order-flow traders who want conviction behind each gap.

indicators.name: Dynamic Momentum Index
indicators.description: Chande and Kroll's variable-length RSI: the 14-period base is divided by a volatility index (5-bar standard deviation over its 10-bar average) and clamped between 5 and 30 bars, so readings turn faster in volatile phases and steadier in quiet ones. Plots the adaptive oscillator with 70/30 levels, a midline gradient, an optional effective-length stepline and a dashboard.

indicators.name: Dynamic Order Blocks
indicators.description: Dynamic Order Blocks keeps the most recent unmitigated bullish and bearish order block on the chart, plus the average level between them as an adaptive support/resistance line. Mitigation breaks hint at trend direction, and bordered boxes mark level sweeps: failed breakouts that can precede reversals. A minimal, always-current order block read for price action traders.

indicators.name: Dynamic Time Warping Similarity
indicators.description: Searches history for the windows whose shape most resembles the last 30 bars, comparing z-normalized windows with dynamic time warping under a Sakoe-Chiba band. The closest non-overlapping analogs are boxed on the chart with optional aftermath zones showing what followed, ranked in a dashboard by DTW distance, with alerts when the best match crosses the strong-match threshold.

indicators.name: Ease of Movement
indicators.description: Ease of Movement relates the bar-to-bar shift in the high-low midpoint to a box ratio of volume over range, producing an oscillator around zero that reads high when price advances on light volume and low when movement requires heavy volume. Defaults apply a 14-period simple moving average to the raw one-bar values. This is Richard Arms' indicator in its standard form.

indicators.name: Effort vs Result
indicators.description: Normalizes each bar's volume (effort) and price movement (result) against 20-bar averages and plots their balance around a harmony baseline. Diamonds mark heavy effort with little result (the absorption warning), circles mark easy movement on thin volume, and completed swing legs are compared with the prior leg in the same direction for exhaustion divergences.

indicators.name: Ehlers Instantaneous Trendline
indicators.description: The simplified single-alpha recursion John Ehlers published for his low-lag trendline, computed on the bar midpoint with Alpha 0.07 and paired with a trigger line projected two bars ahead of it. Line, trigger and gradient fill share the cross-state color, and alerts cover trigger crosses and slope reversals. A faithful low-lag alternative to a fixed moving average.

indicators.name: Ehlers SuperSmoother
indicators.description: John Ehlers' Butterworth-derived low-pass filter drawn as a slope-colored line: choose a 10-bar Cutoff Period and 2 or 3 Poles, and fluctuations faster than the cutoff are sharply rejected while slower swings keep their shape. A gradient fill marks price's side of the filter, with alerts on price crosses and slope turns. Smoothing with less lag per unit of noise removed.

indicators.name: Elastic Volume-weighted MA
indicators.description: Christian Fries' elastic volume-weighted moving average: a recursive line where each bar's influence equals its share of a volume budget (20 bars of summed volume by default, or the share float for a cost-basis read). Options add a slower pair line, a comparison EMA and a 10% stretch alert, with slope coloring and a dashboard showing how much of the line each bar rewrote.

indicators.name: Elder Impulse System
indicators.description: The Elder Impulse System colors each price bar by combining the slope of a 13-period EMA with the slope of the MACD histogram: green when both rise, red when both fall, and neutral when they disagree. It condenses trend direction and momentum agreement into a single bar-color overlay. This is the plain, unmodified version of the system with its standard EMA 13 and MACD histogram inputs.

indicators.name: Elder Ray
indicators.description: Elder Ray measures buying and selling pressure relative to trend by subtracting a 13-period EMA from the bar's high (Bull Power) and from the bar's low (Bear Power), plotting each as a histogram. Positive Bull Power shows buyers pushing price above the average; negative Bear Power shows sellers pulling it below. This build is the standard raw implementation with the classic EMA length of 13.

indicators.name: Elder SafeZone Stop
indicators.description: Trails Alexander Elder's SafeZone stop: adverse penetrations averaged over a 20-bar lookback, multiplied by a 2.5 noise coefficient and hung from the previous bar's extreme, ratcheting so the trail never gives ground. Auto mode flips sides when the stop is hit, a dashboard reports the distance and level, and both stop hits carry alerts.

indicators.name: Elegant Oscillator
indicators.description: Plots John Ehlers' Elegant Oscillator: a 2-bar price derivative normalized by its 50-bar root mean square, compressed by the inverse Fisher transform and finished with a 20-period SuperSmoother, bounded between -1 and +1. Dashed rails at 0.9 mark one-sided momentum, and eight alerts cover zero crosses, rail reaches and fades, and exhaustion events.

indicators.name: Elliott Guidelines
indicators.description: Scores a rule-valid five-wave count against the five Elliott guidelines (alternation, equality, channeling, depth and personality) as a PASS/MISS scorecard with the measured reading behind every grade. Swing points confirm on a 10-bar pivot length, while equality targets, the W2-W4 channel and the lesser-degree fourth-wave zone project where wave 5 may end.

indicators.name: Elliott Hard Rules
indicators.description: Validates the six most recent swing points as a five-wave Elliott count against the three hard rules and draws the exact invalidation prices: the wave-1 origin, the wave-5 cap active while wave 3 lags wave 1, and the wave-1 extreme that wave 4 must not re-enter. Levels turn solid when broken, a dashboard renders the verdict, and every breach fires a recount alert.

indicators.name: Elliott Wave
indicators.description: Elliott Wave detects and labels impulse and corrective wave counts automatically from zigzag pivots, drawing Fibonacci retracements where corrections may rebound. Invalidated counts switch to dotted or dashed lines, and alerts fire on new or broken patterns. Wave analysis without hand-labeling every swing.

indicators.name: Elliptic Filter
indicators.description: Smooths price with a true elliptic (Cauer) low-pass design built from four targets (a 20-bar cutoff period, order 4, 0.5 dB passband ripple and 40 dB stopband attenuation), realized as cascaded biquad sections and drawn as a slope-colored line. A dashboard reports the realized passband and derived stopband edge, with alerts on turns and price crossings.

indicators.name: Embedded Readings
indicators.description: Watches a bounded oscillator (Stochastic by default, with RSI and Williams %R options) for embedding: 3 consecutive closes beyond the 80/20 (or 70/30) extreme thresholds, the working rule that flips extreme readings from reversal warnings into trend confirmation. Labels mark embedding confirmed and lost, a dashboard tracks the run, and four alerts cover the transitions.

indicators.name: Engulfing Bar
indicators.description: Flags full-range engulfing bars (a high above the prior high, a low below the prior low and a close beyond the prior extreme in the new direction) with significance filters for range expansion, close location, trend context, swing location and volume. Each signal maps a trigger and a protective stop as dashed levels, with alerts for signals, trigger breaks and invalidations.

indicators.name: Ensemble Voting of Signals
indicators.description: Polls nine classic components (EMA cross, price vs SMA, RSI, MACD, Stochastic %K, Bollinger %B, Donchian position, OBV trend and MFI) as weighted voters and plots the smoothed net consensus on a -100 to +100 scale. Thresholds at 20 and 60 band the score into Buy, Sell and Strong ratings, and a dashboard lists every voter's verdict, family and weight.

indicators.name: EQH/EQL FVG Breakouts
indicators.description: EQH/EQL identifies equal highs and equal lows, which function as key liquidity zones in the market. Traders use these patterns to spot potential breakout opportunities or to anticipate reactions once price sweeps these levels. The indicator tracks active zones and confirms significant breakout signals by requiring associated Fair Value Gaps and ATR-based strength filters. This provides a systematic way to monitor liquidity-dense areas and capture momentum following a breakout or sweep.

indicators.name: EQH/EQL Liquidity Zones
indicators.description: EQH/EQL Liquidity Zones detects equal highs and equal lows from confirmed pivots and extends them as zones until price sweeps them. Nearby zones merge into clusters such as 2x EQH with summed pivot volume, ranking where stops are likely stacked. For liquidity-focused traders who want sweep targets mapped objectively.

indicators.name: EquiVolume
indicators.description: EquiVolume redraws the visible chart with candle widths scaled to traded volume, stretching busy bars wide and squeezing quiet ones thin. Optional intrabar analysis fills each candle with the share of lower-timeframe volume and candles moving in its direction. Price and volume in a single plot, with no separate pane to cross-reference.

indicators.name: Ergodic Oscillator
indicators.description: William Blau's double-smoothed momentum ratio scaled to +/-100: one-bar price change run through 20- and 5-length EMA stages and divided by the same pipeline on absolute change, paired with a 5-period signal line and a histogram of the gap. Columns brighten while the gap widens and fade as it narrows, with alerts on crosses, zero flips and extreme-band entries.

indicators.name: Evasive SuperTrend
indicators.description: The Evasive SuperTrend rebuilds the classic volatility band with noise-avoidance logic: when price drifts into an ATR-defined Noise Zone, the band expands away instead of waiting to be hit. Dotted evasive segments, a gradient strength fill, and BULL/BEAR flip labels give trend followers cleaner signals and fewer whipsaws in choppy conditions.

indicators.name: Even-better Sinewave
indicators.description: Implements Ehlers' even-better sinewave: price high-pass filtered at a 40-bar duration, smoothed by a 10-bar SuperSmoother and normalized by its own recent power so the wave holds between -1 and +1. Pinning beyond 0.9 for 5 bars confirms an established trend and tints the pane; six alerts cover zero crosses, saturation and saturation ending.

indicators.name: Evening Star
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of the evening star: a long bullish candle, a small star and a long bearish candle closing at least 50% into the first body, each sized against the average real body of the preceding bars. Optional uptrend, RSI and volume filters cut mid-range noise, and confirmed patterns print labels, highlights and dashed trigger and stop levels with alerts.

indicators.name: EWMA Volatility
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of EWMA volatility: the RiskMetrics recursion on squared log returns with a 0.94 decay factor, annualized by default at 252 bars per year and drawn with a gradient fill. An equal-weight comparison line, percentile thresholds at 80 and 20 and a dashboard with a half-life readout separate building turbulence from decay.

indicators.name: Excess
indicators.description: Builds a TPO count map for each completed profile session (daily by default, from 30-minute TPO periods across 25 rows) and marks excess wherever at least 2 consecutive single-print rows tail off a session extreme. Confirmed tails extend right as support and resistance references until price trades through them, a forming tail shows live, and four alerts track formation and breaks.

indicators.name: Execution Algo Footprints
indicators.description: Scores the tape 0-100 for signs of a working institutional execution program (uniform intrabar slice sizes, one-sided delta, pressure persisting through pullbacks and volume-scaled participation) over a 30-bar window against a 50 threshold. Detections confirm after 60 minutes and 1 ATR of worked price span, a dashboard itemizes every component, and four alerts track the lifecycle.

indicators.name: Exhaustion Bar
indicators.description: Detects exhaustion bars: a fresh 20-bar extreme after a 2 ATR directional move, printed on a range at least 1.5x the recent average (optionally with a 1.5x volume spike), yet closing within the opposite 25% of the bar. Wick-tip levels extend forward as stop and invalidation references, next-bar confirmation is optional, and six alerts cover detection, confirmation and invalidation.

indicators.name: Exhaustion Gap
indicators.description: Flags gaps printing late in an extended trend (after 20 bars on one side of a 50-period average with 1.5 ATR of stretch, on climactic volume and range) as exhaustion candidates, then grades them: a fill within 5 bars confirms exhaustion, an opposite gap confirms an island, and staying open re-labels the gap as continuation behavior. Nine alerts track every stage.

indicators.name: Exotic Harmonics
indicators.description: The definitive clean build for exotic harmonic patterns: Nen Star, White Swan and Black Swan XABCD structures detected from alternating confirmed swings, each leg checked against configurable Fibonacci ratio windows. Completions draw the legs, measured ratios, an embedded AB=CD projection and a risk template with invalidation and 0.382 / 0.618 targets.

indicators.name: Expanded Cloud
indicators.description: The Expanded Cloud wraps price in a trailing, price-reactive cloud built from Donchian extremes, with dots marking each new trend phase and cloud width tracking how hard a move is expanding. A built-in dashboard reports PNL, expectancy, and average first-touch statistics for the cloud's signals, giving trend followers a visual system they can also quantify.

indicators.name: Expiration Effects
indicators.description: Maps the US derivatives expiration calendar onto the chart: monthly OpEx third Fridays, quarterly witching dates and VIX expiry Wednesdays are labeled and shaded along with OpEx week, while a dashboard counts down upcoming dates and measures each window's average session range, absolute change and relative volume from the symbol's own history. Five alerts track window opens and session starts.

indicators.name: Extrapolated Previous Trend
indicators.description: The Extrapolated Previous Trend fits a linear trend to each completed interval and projects it into the current one, turning the prior slope into a live forecast line. Projections double as support and resistance, and a dashboard scores how persistently uptrends and downtrends carry between intervals. Built for traders who want trend persistence made measurable.

indicators.name: Fair Value Gap
indicators.description: The Fair Value Gap indicator detects bullish and bearish imbalances the moment a three-bar sequence leaves a void, draws each gap as a box, and clears it once price returns to fill it. Automatic volatility thresholds, multi-timeframe detection, optional mitigation levels, and a dashboard of gap counts and fill rates keep imbalance traders focused on the zones that still matter.

indicators.name: Fair Value Gap Absorption Indicator
indicators.description: The Fair Value Gap Absorption Indicator detects three-candle imbalances and then tracks how much of each gap price has worked back through, printing live mitigation percentages until a new gap takes over. A width filter tunes detection sensitivity and historical gaps stay reviewable, giving traders a running gauge of how completely inefficiencies get repaired.

indicators.name: Fair Value Gaps Mitigation Oscillator
indicators.description: The Fair Value Gaps Mitigation Oscillator compresses imbalance analysis into one pane: it tracks a chosen number of recent gaps, measures how much of each remains unfilled, and normalizes the total between +1 and -1. Histogram bars size every new gap against the outstanding total, so trend strength shows up as imbalances the market refuses to repair.

indicators.name: False Breakout
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of false breakout detection: confirmed swing highs and lows become watched levels, a break starts a failure watch, and a close back inside within the window confirms the trap. Bull Trap and Bear Trap labels mark the extremes, shaded zones frame each failed excursion, and an optional filter demands heavy re-entry volume.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Bollinger Bands
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of Fibonacci Bollinger Bands: a 200-period VWMA basis with an outer rail three standard deviations away, subdivided at 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618 and 0.764 into a ladder of interior rungs. Gradient fills, right-edge rung labels and alerts on basis crosses, rung crossings and outer-rail tags make every level readable.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Confluence Toolkit
indicators.description: The Fibonacci Confluence Toolkit chains CHoCH detection, automatic areas of interest, and self-anchoring Fibonacci retracements into a single reversal workflow, then marks engulfing candles that confirm inside the zones. Detection runs on pure price action with no manual anchoring, giving traders an objective read on where pullbacks are likely to turn.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Grid
indicators.description: The Fibonacci Grid lays a lattice of 45-degree diagonals across the chart, spacing them by Fibonacci ratios applied to the highest and lowest prices of a lookback window, or switching to equidistant lines on demand. Converging diagonals frame channels that contain price until a breakout, handing traders ready-made diagonal support and resistance.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Pivots
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of Fibonacci pivots: the prior period's (H+L+C)/3 central pivot with support and resistance tiers at 38.2%, 61.8% and 100% of the prior range, plus optional 23.6% and 138.2% rungs. Daily, weekly or monthly anchors, an R1–S1 rotation zone, level labels and close-based cross alerts on the pivot and every standard tier.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Progression with Breaks
indicators.description: Fibonacci Progression with Breaks flags each point where price deviates significantly from a central level, then raises the bar by scaling the next threshold through Fibonacci sequence multipliers. Checkmarks and crosses grade deviations with the trend, break labels reset the level once the sequence is exhausted, and plotted extremities act as support and resistance.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Ranges (Real-Time)
indicators.description: Fibonacci Ranges (Real-Time) builds live Fibonacci channels from the latest swing high and low, keeping each range on the chart until a chosen number of consecutive closes escapes its break levels. Breakout labels flag potential reversals, shadows preserve prior channels as support and resistance, and a Latest Fibonacci mode tracks the current swing throughout.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Toolkit
indicators.description: The Fibonacci Toolkit packs six Fibonacci drawing tools into one indicator: retracements, arcs, circles, fans, timezones, and spirals, all calculated from a single pair of user-set anchor points. A drop-down menu switches between tools and the default ratios remain adjustable, making it a complete Fibonacci workbench for support, resistance, and timing analysis.

indicators.name: Fibonacci Trailing Stop
indicators.description: The Fibonacci Trailing Stop derives a trailing stop line from Fibonacci levels of the most recent swing high and low, moving only in the trend's direction until price breaks through it. A selectable level and close-or-wick trigger tune how tight it runs, while shadows of past Fibonacci patterns expose support and resistance zones worth watching.

indicators.name: Final Flag
indicators.description: Finds Al Brooks' final flag: a tight, horizontal flag late in a trend of at least 5 ATR with earlier pushes, closing through the trend's trendline, whose breakout to a new extreme fails back into the flag within five bars. The reversal is traded with a stop beyond the breakout extreme toward the start of the final leg, and failed failures that resume the trend are flagged.

indicators.name: Firefly Oscillator
indicators.description: Plots the Firefly oscillator: a z-score of the weighted price (high + low + 2 x close) / 4 against its 10-bar EMA basis, double-smoothed with a 3-period zero-lag pass and rescaled so 50 is neutral on a roughly 0-100 scale, with a glow that flares toward extremes. Dashed 80/20 levels mark stretched readings, optional divergence detection compares confirmed swings, and eight alerts cover crosses, fades and divergences.

indicators.name: Fisher Transform
indicators.description: The Fisher Transform normalizes price over a lookback window and applies the inverse hyperbolic tangent, producing an oscillator with a near-Gaussian distribution that sharpens turning points. It plots the transform alongside its one-bar-lagged signal line, using the common default of length 9 applied to the hl2 price. This is the standard raw implementation of the indicator with no additional processing.

indicators.name: Fixed Time Cycles
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of fixed time cycles: pick an anchor, set a period N, and vertical cycle lines project at every Nth bar with shaded turn windows around each. The anchor can snap to the nearest confirmed swing, and a dashboard audits the model honestly: median swing spacing versus N, spacing variability, and the share of windows that caught a turn.

indicators.name: Flat
indicators.description: Detects Elliott flat corrections from confirmed swings: an A-B-C sequence where wave B retraces at least 90% of wave A and sub-wave counts fit the 3-3-5 blueprint, classified as regular, expanded or running. Developing setups project wave C targets at 1.0 and 1.618 extensions of A, completed patterns are drawn with legs, labels and measured ratios, and seven alerts span setups, traps and completions.

indicators.name: Flat Base
indicators.description: Detects IBD-style flat bases: shelves of at least 5 bars correcting no more than 15% after a prior advance of 20% or more, boxed live with a pivot buy line, a range-low stop reference and a quality grade built from tight closes and contracting volume. Breakouts through the pivot are split into volume-confirmed and weak-volume events, with four alerts covering formation through invalidation.

indicators.name: Floor Pivots
indicators.description: The definitive clean build of floor pivots: the classic (H+L+C)/3 pivot with R1–R3 and S1–S3 fanned around it from the prior day, week, month or year, rolling at each period boundary without repainting. A selectable classic or range-multiple R3/S3 formula, per-tier visibility, level labels and close-based cross alerts on P and every tier.

indicators.name: Follow-through Day
indicators.description: Applies O'Neil's follow-through rules to an index or index ETF: once a correction sets in, each rally attempt is numbered from Day 1, the count restarts when Day 1's low is undercut, and a follow-through prints on Day 4 or later with a 1.25% gain on higher volume. The rally low then becomes the failure level, and early distribution days after the signal are flagged.

indicators.name: Force Index
indicators.description: Force Index multiplies the change in close from the prior bar by the current bar's volume, then smooths the result with an exponential moving average, plotting an oscillator around zero that combines price direction, extent, and volume. The default is Alexander Elder's intermediate-term setting of a 13-period EMA. The calculation is the standard published formula without modification.

indicators.name: Forward-Backward Exponential Oscillator
indicators.description: A normalized momentum oscillator built on forward-backward EMA filtering. It plots a steadier forward value against a more reactive backward value, with a histogram of their difference centered at 50 and a projection of estimated future readings ahead of the latest bar. For traders who want EMA-based momentum shifts with less lag.

indicators.name: Fractal Nesting
indicators.description: Three degrees of swing structure on one chart: raw pivots (Base Pivot Length 1) build a short-term zigzag whose swings stack recursively into intermediate-term and long-term paths. Degree tags, a full-alignment background tint and a per-degree dashboard of leg direction and latest pivots give structure traders a multi-scale read without extra charts.

indicators.name: FRAMA
indicators.description: John Ehlers' fractal adaptive moving average: the smoothing factor is re-derived each bar from a box-counting fractal dimension of the last 16 bars' highs and lows, so the line stiffens in noise and accelerates in trends. Regime coloring against an ATR-normalized flat threshold and a dashboard with the live dimension, alpha and EMA-equivalent length complete the build.

indicators.name: Futures Roll Dates
indicators.description: Tracks the futures roll from the chart's own root: front and next contract volume print side by side with open interest lines, the scheduled window ahead of quarterly or monthly expirations is shaded, and markers stamp the day volume leadership passes and the day open interest migrates. A dashboard adds the roll spread, curve state and a front OI collapse check, plus splice-gap warnings on continuous charts.

indicators.name: FVG + Liquidity Sweep + CISD
indicators.description: Automates the PAC Method reversal sequence on one chart: price enters a higher timeframe fair value gap, sweeps local liquidity, confirms a change in state of delivery, and a local FVG in the new direction triggers a triangle signal. Built for lower timeframe traders who execute inside institutional points of interest.

indicators.name: FVG Channel
indicators.description: Averages recent unmitigated fair value gaps into a five-band channel, with inner bands set at Fibonacci ratios of the outer extremes. It tracks trend health through band interactions, marks last-stand breakout levels, and fires reversal signals once one side's gaps are fully mitigated. For price action traders who want structure drawn from imbalances.

indicators.name: FVG Instantaneous Mitigation Signals
indicators.description: Detects fair value gaps that are filled just one bar after forming and fires a signal in the opposite direction of the gap. Each signal can be framed with ATR-based take-profit and stop-loss areas plus a trailing stop with configurable reset rules, giving reversal traders an entry-to-exit workflow built around rapid mitigations.

indicators.name: FVG Positioning Average
indicators.description: Averages the initiation prices of recent fair value gaps into a Bull Average and a Bear Average: an estimate of where aggressive buyers and sellers built their positions. Each line shows only on its own side of price and acts as support or resistance, while both appearing at once flags a contested market. Useful for entries, exits, and stops.

indicators.name: FVG Price & Volume Graph
indicators.description: Plots recent fair value gaps on a price-versus-volume graph, measuring participation inside each imbalance from intrabar data. The heaviest gaps anchor extended support and resistance levels, and a regression line sketches where future gaps may cluster. For traders who rank imbalances by the liquidity behind them.

indicators.name: FVG Sessions
indicators.description: Highlights the first fair value gap of every trading session, extends it through the session close, and outlines the session range around it. Mitigated gaps turn transparent to flag potential inversion, and alerts cover gap formation, mitigation, entries, and average crosses. Built for intraday traders who anchor to opening imbalances.

indicators.name: FVG Trailing Stop
indicators.description: A trend-following trailing stop derived from the extremes of unmitigated fair value gaps, averaged per direction and smoothed with a simple moving average. Price above the line reads bullish, below reads bearish, and an optional Reset on Cross mode steps aside during unclear phases. For traders who anchor exits to imbalances, not fixed distances.

indicators.name: Gann Box
indicators.description: A Gann Box between a swing low and swing high, anchored automatically to confirmed swings (Swing Length 20) or snapped to the extremes of a manual date range, and subdivided in both price and time: Eighths by default, with Quarters, Thirds, Halves or Fibonacci schemes. Corner diagonals, squaring intersections, right-extended levels and projected time divisions are optional.

indicators.name: Gann Fan & Angles
indicators.description: The classical nine-angle Gann fan with the scaling decision made explicit: the 1x1 is defined in price units per bar, derived from ATR at the anchor (length 14, multiplier 1) or set manually, so levels survive zoom and re-scaling. Auto swing anchoring over a 200-bar lookback, per-pair angle toggles, crossing alerts and an info panel showing the active unit and bracketing angles.

indicators.name: Gann HiLo Activator
indicators.description: Robert Krausz's stepped trailing line built clean: a 3-period average of highs and another of lows, with the close deciding which side plots. The averaged lows trail under price as support while the state is up, the averaged highs cap price as resistance while it is down. Flip markers, a gradient trail fill, and alerts for flips and held pullback tests complete a one-parameter trend tool.

indicators.name: Gann Method
indicators.description: Applies W.D. Gann's toolkit to one swing at a time: a mechanical swing chart and its trend rule pick the anchor, angles are drawn from it at the anchor swing's own price-per-bar rate, the swing's range is divided into quarters, thirds and the 50% point, and the bar where elapsed time equals the swing's duration is marked with calendar-day counts. Levels and dates are references for price to confirm.

indicators.name: Gann Square of 9 Vibration Levels
indicators.description: Projects horizontal support and resistance from W.D. Gann's Square of 9, converting 45, 90, 180, and 360 degree rotations into price levels from an automatic swing pivot or a manual anchor. Solid cardinal lines, dashed ordinal lines, and a live dashboard give breakout, reversal, and swing traders structured, rule-based targets.

indicators.name: Gap Fill Breakouts
indicators.description: Tracks ATR-filtered fair value gaps as price works to fill them, shrinking each box to its unfilled remainder, and prints triangle signals when price breaks a structural pivot near an active gap. With breakout alerts built in, it suits traders who want imbalance and market structure aligned before acting on a break.

indicators.name: Gap Rules Interaction
indicators.description: Reads each session's opening gap against the prior day's map and the opening range on intraday charts: gaps are sized against a 10-day average daily range, classed as inside or beyond the prior range, and the 30-minute opening range is graded as accepting or rejecting the gap. A dashboard layers gap fill, the gapped-over level and a live day read, with eleven alerts from classification through negation.

indicators.name: Gap-volatility Relation
indicators.description: Splits total variance into overnight and intraday components and plots the overnight share as a percentage against a dashed 50% threshold, from 20-session sample variances by default. A dashboard adds annualized component volatilities, gap frequency, average gap size, fill rate and a Quiet/Normal/Stressed regime read, for traders sizing overnight risk on gapping instruments.

indicators.name: GARCH-family Clustering
indicators.description: Conditional volatility from GARCH(1,1), GJR-GARCH(1,1) or EGARCH(1,1): coefficients come from a rolling quasi-MLE grid fit over a 250-bar window or manual entry, with the long-run anchor pinned by variance targeting. A decaying multi-step forecast, optional EWMA benchmark, regime shading, shock marks and a persistence and half-life dashboard expose the model's mechanics.

indicators.name: Garman-Klass Estimator
indicators.description: Historical volatility from the published Garman-Klass formula: per-bar variance from the high-low range recentered by the open-to-close leg, averaged over a 20-bar window and annualized at 252 bars per year. A same-settings close-to-close overlay makes the efficiency gain visible and diagnoses gap blind spots and session churn, with percentile expansion and compression alerts.

indicators.name: Garman-Klass–Yang-Zhang Hybrid
indicators.description: The Garman-Klass-Yang-Zhang estimator in a pane: the classic range-based variance with the squared close-to-open jump prepended, so overnight gaps are booked instead of dropped, averaged over 20 bars and annualized at 252 per year. A plain Garman-Klass comparison line and an overnight-share readout isolate gap-driven variance, with percentile expansion and compression alerts.

indicators.name: Gator Oscillator
indicators.description: Plots the Alligator's line spreads as two mirrored histograms around zero (jaw minus teeth above, teeth minus lips below), built from Wilder-smoothed averages of median price at the original 13/8, 8/5 and 5/3 lengths and offsets. Columns color green as a side expands and red as it contracts, and a dashboard names the current feeding phase and how long it has lasted.

indicators.name: Gaussian Filter
indicators.description: John Ehlers' recursive Gaussian filter as a trend baseline: price runs through up to four cascaded single-pole stages (Period 14, Poles 4), pushing the combined response toward the Gaussian bell for a rounder, steadier line than a one-stage smoother of the same period. Slope-based coloring, a price/filter gradient fill, optional crossing markers and four alerts are built in.

indicators.name: Gaussian Mixture Models
indicators.description: Fits a two- or three-component Gaussian mixture to returns and volatility over a rolling 200-observation window, plotting each regime's probability from 0 to 100% with variance-ordered components, confidence-scaled candle coloring and an EM diagnostics dashboard. Defaults to 2 components, warm-start updates and 3-bar probability smoothing, for traders who want probabilistic regime context.

indicators.name: Gaussian Volume Profile
indicators.description: Rebuilds the volume profile as a smooth density curve by fitting a Sum of Gaussians with Levenberg-Marquardt optimization. Detected peaks are drawn as precise liquidity centers, and each node's width separates tight consensus zones from broad value areas. For volume traders who want cleaner levels than a jagged histogram provides.

indicators.name: GMMA / MA Ribbon
indicators.description: This build plots Daryl Guppy's GMMA as a ribbon of exponential moving averages in two groups: a short-term set with lengths 3 through 15 and a long-term set with lengths 30 through 60. Ribbon coloring reflects the relationship between the two groups, making compression and expansion of the averages easy to read. It is the standard Guppy construction using the classic length sets.

indicators.name: Golden Cross
indicators.description: Tracks the classic 50/200 moving average pair, grading every golden cross by the slow MA's slope: bullish when flat or rising, caution when still falling. Invalidation marks, whipsaw flags and a regime fill between the averages complete the picture, while a dashboard reports slope, separation and the advance already consumed at the cross. Defaults to 50/200 SMAs on close.

indicators.name: Golden Pocket
indicators.description: Anchors the 0.618-0.65 golden pocket automatically across confirmed swing legs, then tracks each band through a fresh, tested, broken or invalidated lifecycle: wick tests, closing breaks, and an invalidation line at the 0.786 retracement by default. Detects swings confirmed by 20 bars per side, keeps the three most recent pockets, and alerts on entries, rejections, breaks and invalidations.

indicators.name: Gradient Boosting
indicators.description: Trains a walk-forward boosted-trees ensemble on five stationary chart features and plots its prediction as an oscillator: P(up) around a 50 line under log loss by default, or expected forward percent return around zero in regression mode. Early stopping, subsampling and L2 regularization are built in, with a model card reporting validation loss and two feature-importance reads.

indicators.name: Gravestone Doji
indicators.description: Flags inverted-T candles where the body is at most 5% of the range, the lower shadow no more than 10%, and the upper shadow at least twice the body and one 14-period ATR, by default only after price closes above a 50-bar trend average. Dashed trigger and stop levels track each pattern through a 3-bar confirmation window, with alerts on detection, confirmation and invalidation.

indicators.name: Half Cup
indicators.description: Detects half-formed cup shapes, wraps them in a curved channel, and prints green or red dots as price breaks above or below it, trading the pattern while it is still developing. Broadness, shift, and validation thresholds control what qualifies. An anticipatory take on the Cup and Handle for pattern-focused traders.

indicators.name: Halftrend
indicators.description: A definitive clean rebuild of the Halftrend stop-and-reverse line: in up states it steps higher only on rising lowest lows beneath price, in down states only on falling highest highs above it, holding still through consolidation. A half-ATR channel marks the tolerance zone, arrows mark flips, and a gradient fill spans price and the line. Defaults: amplitude 2, channel deviation 2.0, 100-bar ATR.

indicators.name: Hanging Man
indicators.description: Detects small-bodied candles near their session high with a lower shadow at least twice the body, printing only after the prior bar closes above a 50-bar advance average. Each detection draws a trigger at the body bottom and a stop at the pattern high, waits up to 3 bars for a confirming close, then keeps tracking the stop for 20 more, with alerts at every stage.

indicators.name: Harami
indicators.description: Detects bullish and bearish harami patterns on real bodies, filtered for a wide first candle versus its 14-bar average body, a maximum inner body of 50%, and a directional leg gauged by a 50-length moving average. Doji inside candles upgrade labels to Harami Cross, and dashed trigger and void levels resolve each pattern by close, with alerts for detection, confirmation and cancellation.

indicators.name: Harmonic MA
indicators.description: Smooths price with the harmonic mean, the window length divided by the sum of reciprocal prices, over 20 bars by default and next to a same-length SMA for comparison. Slope coloring, a price/MA gradient fill and crossing alerts carry the read, while a dashboard quotes the harmonic line's percentage gap to its arithmetic sibling and flags windows holding non-positive data.

indicators.name: Harmonic Pattern Detection
indicators.description: Anchor five XABCD vertices on the chart and this tool classifies the formation as a Bat, Gartley, Butterfly, or Crab, draws every segment with its measured ratio, and projects the Potential Reversal Zone around point D. Alerts fire as price reaches the PRZ. A precision companion for discretionary harmonic traders who want the measuring done for them.

indicators.name: Head & Shoulders
indicators.description: Detects head and shoulders tops and inverse bottoms from confirmed swings, validating prior trend, shoulder symmetry and neckline tilt before drawing the outline, S/H/S labels and neckline. A pattern completes only on a close through the neckline within 100 bars; breaks, retests, failures and measured objectives are all labeled and alertable, with low-volume breaks flagged.

indicators.name: Hidden Divergence
indicators.description: Scans confirmed price swings against RSI, Stochastic, CCI, MACD or any external series for hidden divergence, a higher low in price against a lower oscillator low and the bearish mirror, gated by a structure (HH/HL) or higher-timeframe MA trend filter. Signals draw lines on both panes, label the confirming swing, and anchor dashed invalidation levels. Defaults: RSI 14 with 5/5 swing confirmation.

indicators.name: High Tight Flag
indicators.description: Detects the strictest growth-stock continuation pattern: a pole that roughly doubles (90%+ by default) within 40 bars, then a 5 to 25 bar flag giving back no more than 25%. A close through the flag high on 1.4x average volume confirms, then a flag-height target, a stop at the flag low and a back-inside-the-flag failure rule manage the trade, with a dashboard grading pole, flag and volume.

indicators.name: High-wave Candle
indicators.description: Marks sessions whose upper and lower shadows each reach at least twice the body and 0.6x the 20-bar average range, with a small body near the range center. Each detection extends its extremes forward as a bracket that resolves on a close beyond either side, with optional trend-context and volume filters and six alerts running from detection to resolution.

indicators.name: High/Low Location Frequency
indicators.description: A statistics dashboard that measures where your market's tops and bottoms actually tend to print: by hour of day, day of week, day of month, and month of year. Exclusion filters strip out unwanted hours, days, months, or years, and high-probability periods can be flagged as lines and labels right on the chart. Timing evidence for session-aware traders.

indicators.name: Higher Timeframe Stochastic Buckets
indicators.description: The Higher Timeframe Stochastic Buckets indicator visually highlights zones of market exhaustion by calculating stochastic values on a user defined higher timeframe. Traders use these buckets to identify potential overbought or oversold conditions, helping to spot reversal opportunities. The tool provides volume and delta data within these zones to gauge market sentiment and offers optional lower timeframe RSI signal confirmation for more precise trade setups.

indicators.name: Hikkake
indicators.description: Detects the hikkake inside-bar trap: a one-sided false break of an inside bar that snaps back through the opposite extreme within a 3-bar window by default. Each armed setup draws the inside-bar zone, trigger level and invalidation line; triggered patterns are labeled with the false-break extreme and elapsed bars. Filters can cap inside-bar size, require trend alignment, or cancel on mother-bar follow-through.

indicators.name: Hilbert Transform
indicators.description: Runs Ehlers' Hilbert transform cycle engine on the bar midpoint: a homodyne discriminator measures the dominant cycle period, clamped to 6-50 bars, and the pane plots either the sinewave with its 45-degree lead line or the period estimate itself. A 6 dB signal-to-noise gate dims output when cycle amplitude is noise, a background flags trend mode, and a dashboard reports period, phase, amplitude, SNR and mode.

indicators.name: Historical Correlation
indicators.description: Measures how up to 10 ticker pairs have correlated from any anchor point you set, drawn as evolving line plots or as a heatmap of the latest readings. Optional anchor periods restart the calculation every hour, day, week, month, quarter, or year. Backbone statistics for pair traders, hedgers, and anyone balancing a portfolio.

indicators.name: Historical Liquidity Proximity Heatmap
indicators.description: Maps the historical swing levels nearest to current price as a volume-graded field of heatmap dots: pivot highs stacked above, pivot lows below, each colored by the volume that formed it. Two volume-weighted average lines distill the field into clean breakout references. Nearby liquidity, mapped without the clutter of every old level.

indicators.name: Historical Price Projection
indicators.description: Pick any stretch of past price action and this tool replays its behavior forward from an anchor you set, producing a projected path plus a configurable forecast area. A growth factor from 0 to 100 injects drift drawn from the anchored period's own returns, shifting the projection's expectancy. For traders who study how market phases rhyme.

indicators.name: Historical Volatility
indicators.description: Historical Volatility measures the dispersion of an instrument's returns by taking the standard deviation of logarithmic close-to-close changes over a lookback window and annualizing the result, plotted as a single percentage line. Defaults use a length of 10 bars with annualization applied. This is the standard raw implementation of close-to-close historical volatility with no additional processing.

indicators.name: Horns Pattern Identifier
indicators.description: Scans the chart for horn tops and bottoms (the twin-spike reversal formations from Bulkowski's chart-pattern research) in both regular and inverted form. Each detection is drawn with its confirmation level and a measured take-profit target, and a bullish or bearish label prints the moment price breaks confirmation. A focused scanner for reversal traders.

indicators.name: Hot Zone Radar
indicators.description: A liquidity weather map: the Radar Dashboard renders evolving volume concentration as a scrolling thermal heatmap, while gradient boxes project the strongest clusters onto the chart as adaptive support and resistance. A status readout classifies conditions as HOT, WARM, COLD, or STABLE, telling you at a glance whether range or breakout tactics fit.

indicators.name: HTF Candle Consistency
indicators.description: Paints your candles by the verdict of up to 10 higher timeframes: green when their recent candles lean bullish, red when bearish, with a neutral tone when no majority exists. Per-timeframe weights tune the vote, and a dashboard breaks out each timeframe's direction. A one-glance trend filter for multi-timeframe traders.

indicators.name: HTF Candle Dynamics
indicators.description: Projects the developing higher timeframe candle beside current price, complete with live OHLC levels, an intraperiod volume profile, and a polyline tracing how the point of control has migrated. A history dashboard summarizes the previous three HTF candles with OHLC and volume delta. Daily or weekly context, kept on the chart you execute from.

indicators.name: HTF Candle Projections
indicators.description: Draws recent and still-forming higher timeframe candles in the open space to the right of price, tracing each HTF wick back to the exact lower timeframe bar that created it. Internal sentiment bars expose the bull/bear composition inside every candle, and solid lines frame the active HTF range. Macro structure that never leaves your execution chart.

indicators.name: HTF CISD Projections
indicators.description: Detects change-in-state-of-delivery setups, then projects up to five multiplier-based levels from the initial range as graded targets, showing only setups aligned with the 1H and 4H EMA trend. Previous 1H and 4H highs and lows add liquidity context, and an optional rule invalidates any setup that closes back through its range.

indicators.name: HTF Fair Value Gap
indicators.description: Tracks fair value gaps from a higher timeframe while you trade a lower one: background shading flags each bullish or bearish HTF gap, and the most recent gap is drawn as a candle beside price with dashed boundary lines and wicks showing post-formation excursions. A status dashboard reports mitigation at a glance.

indicators.name: HTF PO3
indicators.description: Projects higher timeframe Power of 3 candles into the right margin of your active chart. Grid-locked anchoring keeps the projection aligned at any zoom, dashed origin lines trace each HTF open, high, and low back to the exact bar that set it, and a running volume delta reads the buying and selling pressure behind every phase of the cycle.

indicators.name: HTF Reversal Divergences
indicators.description: Flags potential turning points by pairing higher timeframe reversal candles (engulfing patterns and pin bars) with regular RSI divergences, then projects the developing HTF candle beside live price with its running delta. Built for traders who execute on fast charts but want each entry checked against higher timeframe structure and momentum.

indicators.name: HTF Sweep Signals
indicators.description: Marks liquidity sweeps of the previous higher timeframe high or low without leaving your execution chart: a triangle prints when price pierces the level and closes back inside. A box and open line map the HTF range onto lower timeframes, and an optional trend filter keeps only the sweeps aligned with the prior HTF candle's direction.

indicators.name: HTF Swing Structure Signals
indicators.description: Labels BOS and CHoCH events, filters them through a higher timeframe EMA bias, and auto-draws a 50% retracement level after each trend-aligned break. A triangle prints when price returns to that level, giving structure traders a rule-based pullback framework with adjustable pivot sensitivity and setup expiry.

indicators.name: HTF Volume Spike & Imbalance Projection
indicators.description: Splits a higher timeframe candle open beside live price: bubbles mark lower timeframe volume spikes by size and direction, a histogram maps volume across the candle's range, and three or more same-direction spikes at one price are boxed as stacked imbalances. Ghost and current bars sit side by side so intraday traders keep HTF context in view.

indicators.name: HTF-level Proximity Filters
indicators.description: Gates lower-timeframe signals by their distance to higher-timeframe levels: prior day, week and month high/low/close plus the daily floor pivot ladder, normalized in ATR multiples or percent of price. Clearance mode vetoes signals aimed into a nearby level; proximity mode passes only signals firing at one. Nearest levels plot with glow shading and a dashboard shows the live gates. Default threshold: 0.25 daily ATR.

indicators.name: Hurst Exponent
indicators.description: Estimates the Hurst exponent with classical rescaled-range analysis over a rolling 128-increment window, fitting log R/S against log subsample size across dyadic scales. A 5-bar SMA smooths the raw reading, and regimes are only called once the smoothed H clears a 0.05 neutral band around the 0.5 random-walk benchmark: trending above, mean-reverting below, with alerts and a dashboard quoting fit quality.

indicators.name: HyperTrend
indicators.description: Estimates the underlying linear trend of price in real time (no backpainting, no repainting) and wraps it in channel extremities that act as support and resistance. Slope direction gives the regime, wick touches on the extremities flag retracements and reversals, and a multiplicative factor scales the analysis from short swings to long trends.

indicators.name: Ichimoku Theories
indicators.description: The complete Hosoda framework in one tool: the five Ichimoku lines and kumo plus Time, Wave, and Price Theory. It detects and forecasts time cycles from the Kihon Suchi numbers, classifies basic and complex wave structures, and projects N-wave price targets: a full analytical workflow for traders who use Ichimoku as more than a cloud.

indicators.name: ICT Anchored Market Structures with Validation
indicators.description: Detects short, intermediate, and long-term market structure purely from price (no lookback inputs to tune) and validates every CHoCH and BOS against an ATR deviation zone. Confirmed breaks are separated from liquidity sweeps, which get boxed and labeled, so structure traders can tell a genuine shift from a stop run at a glance.

indicators.name: ICT Concepts
indicators.description: The core Inner Circle Trader toolkit in one indicator: market structure shifts and breaks, order blocks and breakers, fair value gaps and other imbalances, buyside and sellside liquidity, displacement, killzones, and New Week/Day Opening Gaps. A Present mode keeps recent elements clean while historical mode replays how each level played out.

indicators.name: ICT Immediate Rebalance
indicators.description: Detects ICT's immediate rebalance (the pattern where price fills an imbalance instantly instead of leaving a fair value gap) and tracks whether the expected two extension candles follow. Multi-timeframe detection, graded wick levels, and a statistics dashboard help traders judge how the pattern behaves on their market.

indicators.name: ICT Immediate Rebalance Toolkit
indicators.description: Surrounds the immediate rebalance pattern with the context ICT traders check it against: buyside and sellside liquidity, order blocks and breaker blocks, liquidity voids, and ICT macro time windows. Each module is individually configurable, turning a single candle pattern into a complete price action workflow on any timeframe.

indicators.name: ICT Implied Fair Value Gap (IFVG)
indicators.description: Automatic detection of Implied Fair Value Gaps, the ICT imbalance built from a three-candle formation where a large central body is flanked by pronounced shadows. Each zone plots with an extendable average that doubles as dynamic support or resistance, and alerts fire on new bullish and bearish formations. Made for imbalance and smart-money traders.

indicators.name: ICT Killzones
indicators.description: Overlays the ICT Killzones (the New York, London Open, London Close and Asian windows) and ties Fibonacci retracements to each zone's price range. Levels update while a Killzone is active and hold at their last tier afterward, handing session traders repeatable intraday references. Built for charts of 1 hour and below, with forex a natural fit.

indicators.name: ICT Killzones Toolkit
indicators.description: An all-in-one ICT session toolkit that marks the Asian, London, New York and London Close Killzones and detects what forms inside them: order blocks, breaker blocks, fair value gaps and market structure shifts. Session extremes, mean lines and period opens complete the workflow for forex and futures traders running smart-money playbooks.

indicators.name: ICT Macros
indicators.description: Detects and classifies the ICT macro windows (short scheduled intervals in the London and New York hours where algorithmic activity engages liquidity) as accumulation, manipulation or expansion. Each macro's high, low and average project forward as support and resistance, with advance alerts and DST handling. Designed for 1 to 5-minute charts.

indicators.name: ICT Model 2022
indicators.description: Runs the 2022 mentorship sequence bar by bar: a raid of a mapped pool (prior day high or low, Asian or London extremes, equal or old highs and lows), a market structure shift that leaves a fair value gap, then the retracement into that gap. Entry, a stop beyond the raided extreme and the nearest opposing pool as target are drawn, with an optional killzone filter.

indicators.name: ICT NWOG/NDOG & EHPDA
indicators.description: Plots New Week and New Day Opening Gaps alongside ICT's Event Horizon PD Arrays, the mid-levels computed between adjacent gaps. Price tends to rotate back to these zones in consolidating markets, making them standing support, resistance and target levels. A configurable gap count keeps the chart clean for traders working ICT reference levels.

indicators.name: ICT Propulsion Block
indicators.description: Detects ICT propulsion blocks: candles that return to a preceding order block and drive price away, creating a tradable zone of their own. The indicator tracks the parent order blocks, highlights propulsion signals as they form, and clears mitigated zones on request, giving smart-money traders a precise read on these reaction points.

indicators.name: ICT Silver Bullet
indicators.description: Frames the three ICT Silver Bullet hours (London Open 3-4 AM, AM session 10-11 AM and PM session 2-3 PM New York time) and tracks the fair value gaps forming inside each. Four display modes from permissive to ICT's favored super-strict, plus projected support and resistance targets after every session, serve intraday traders on sub-15-minute charts.

indicators.name: ICT Unicorn Model
indicators.description: Detects ICT Unicorn patterns, where a fair value gap overlaps a breaker block after structure flips between lower low and higher high, confirming each on the gap re-test. Confirmed setups plot adjustable risk/reward zones with target and stop areas resolved on the chart, plus an optional trailing stop: a self-contained frame for ICT pattern traders.

indicators.name: Imbalance Detector
indicators.description: Detects three imbalance families in one tool (fair value gaps, opening gaps and volume imbalances) each with adjustable minimum-width filters and optional extension. A built-in dashboard tallies how often every imbalance type appears and the percentage that gets filled, giving price action traders measurable context for zone-based decisions.

indicators.name: Implied Volatility
indicators.description: Plots the implied volatility index matched to the chart symbol (VIX, VXN, RVX, VXD, GVZ, OVX, EVZ, or BVIV/EVIV) with IV Rank and IV Percentile over a 252-session lookback. Regime bands, a 21-session realized-volatility overlay, and a dashboard reporting the IV minus RV premium and 30-day expected move turn options pricing into a stop-and-size read for any trader.

indicators.name: Impulse Leg
indicators.description: Classifies every completed zigzag leg against five impulse criteria (distance and speed versus the prior legs, directional candle share, bar overlap, and internal pullback) labeling confirmed impulses and near-miss candidates on the chart. Origin and extreme levels of the latest impulse anchor retracements and invalidation, and a dashboard scores the newest leg criterion by criterion.

indicators.name: Impulse MACD
indicators.description: A MACD variant that prints exactly zero while a zero-lag average of typical price holds inside a 34-period smoothed high/low band, registering only when price escapes the range. A 9-period signal line, expansion-shaded histogram, ignition alerts on the first print off zero, and an optional on-chart band make the dead zone explicit for trend and breakout traders.

indicators.name: Indicator Configuration Forecasting
indicators.description: Encodes the state of RSI, SMA cross, Supertrend, MACD and ADX into a regime vector, finds the K nearest historical matches, and projects a median forecast path with 25th and 75th percentile bands built from what price actually did next. A transparent, analog-driven way for systematic and discretionary traders to frame forward expectations.

indicators.name: Inertial RSI
indicators.description: An RSI that smooths itself at the source: every bar tests each lookback between your minimum and maximum lengths and keeps the one changing least from the prior reading. The forced-persistence output holds momentum states cleanly, with 50-centerline coloring, a dotted signal line and gradient fill for traders who find the classic oscillator too jumpy.

indicators.name: Inertial Stochastic
indicators.description: A stochastic oscillator with forced persistence: each bar evaluates every lookback in your chosen range and adopts the value closest to the previous reading, damping noise before it reaches the plot. Solid K line, dotted D line and a gradient-filled 50 centerline stay readable in strong trends, built for momentum traders tired of whipsaw extremes.

indicators.name: Initial Balance Breakout Signals
indicators.description: Plots the initial balance (the first hour's range or any custom session) and signals breakouts beyond it, with range extensions, Fibonacci retracement levels, and a forecast built from historical IB behavior. Auto or custom windows cover opening-range, overnight, and multi-session setups, making it a flexible base for intraday breakout traders.

indicators.name: Initial Balance Volume Deficit
indicators.description: A session oscillator that accumulates volume through the first hour of trade, then subtracts every bar that follows, showing whether the rest of the day out-trades the open. Deficit crosses, No Deficit shading, a session-anchored moving average, and historical benchmark lines help intraday traders classify trend, balanced, and exhaustion days.

indicators.name: Institutional Order Flow Strength Classifier
indicators.description: Detects unmitigated order blocks at confirmed structure breaks and scores each zone from 0-100% using displacement and relative volume. Overlap filtering removes redundant boxes and a background plot tracks the strongest active zone. For smart-money and supply-demand traders who want ranked institutional levels instead of clutter.

indicators.name: Intermarket Swing Projection
indicators.description: Projects the swing structure of any external symbol onto the active chart, z-score rescaled so both markets share one price axis. Displays the second market as zigzag swings or forward-extended horizontal levels that often act as support and resistance. Built for traders comparing trend phase, timing, and volatility across related markets.

indicators.name: Internal & External Range Liquidity
indicators.description: Maps a dealing range from the latest major swings: its high and low hold the external liquidity, unfilled fair value gaps inside it are the internal liquidity. A raid of one extreme turns the draw to the nearest internal gap; once that is taken, the draw rotates to the untouched extreme. Raids, runs and fills are labeled, the next draw is plotted, and a dashboard tracks the state.

indicators.name: Internal Candle Strength
indicators.description: Splits every candlestick into stacked rows and scores each from 0% to 100% using trend behavior read from a lower timeframe, exposing where bulls or bears controlled the bar internally. Row size and data timeframe are fully adjustable, giving scalpers fine intrabar entries and swing traders a conviction check hidden from ordinary candles.

indicators.name: Internal Pivot Pattern
indicators.description: Detects pivot highs and lows the moment a candle closes by reading its lower-timeframe data, skipping the multi-bar wait of classic pivot detection. Candles color by the latest pivot direction, zigzag lines track the developing structure, and an accuracy dashboard scores reliability. For traders who want earlier notice of swing turns.

indicators.name: Intraday Intensity
indicators.description: Bostian's volume-pressure gauge in both published forms: the normalized II% oscillator built from 21-bar rolling sums, and the original open-ended cumulative line read by slope. Zero crossings flag the accumulation and distribution sides, and an always-on divergence engine compares price extremes against intensity. Requires a symbol with a genuine volume feed.

indicators.name: Intraday Momentum Index
indicators.description: Chande's RSI-style oscillator computed on candle bodies: up-bar bodies as gains, down-bar bodies as losses over a 14-bar window, scaled 0-100. Dashed 70/30 overbought and oversold bands, a dotted 50 midline with directional gradient fill, and alerts on every band and midline event. Gaps never enter the arithmetic, so it isolates in-session sentiment on any timeframe.

indicators.name: Inverse Fisher Transform
indicators.description: Ehlers' inverse Fisher transform on a selectable base oscillator (a 5-period RSI by default, with Stochastic, SMI, and CCI alternatives) scaled by 0.1, smoothed with a 9-period weighted average, and compressed into a near-binary -1 to +1 state. Crossings of the ±0.5 thresholds supply the conventional triggers; saturation alerts mark the output committing to a rail.

indicators.name: Inverse Head & Shoulders
indicators.description: Detects three-trough bottoms whose middle low undercuts both shoulders, built from 10-bar swing pivots with the head required to print the lowest low of the past 100 bars by default. The neckline extends as a dashed line until a closing breakout confirms the pattern, then a measured target, retest marks and a right-shoulder stop are tracked, with five alerts.

indicators.name: Inversion Fair Value Gaps (IFVG)
indicators.description: Plots inversion fair value gaps: zones where price closed through a gap against its bias, flipping broken bullish gaps into resistance and broken bearish gaps into support. Retest signals with alerts fire when the new role is confirmed, with wick or close preference and an ATR width filter. A real-time tool for traders working mitigated gap levels.

indicators.name: Inverted Hammer
indicators.description: Detects inverted hammers by measurable proportions (an upper shadow at least 2x the real body, a lower shadow within 10% of range) and only after an established decline. Each detection is tracked through a 3-bar confirmation window with dashed trigger and stop levels, volume grading via an IH+ tag, and alerts covering detection, every confirmation rule, and invalidation.

indicators.name: IPO Base
indicators.description: Tracks a recent listing's first post-debut consolidation through a full state machine: qualifying pullback, forming range, defined buy point and invalidation, then breakout with a 40% volume-pickup check. Shakeout probes get a 2-bar snapback tolerance, the 90-180 day lockup window is shaded, and a watchlist dashboard reads depth, tightening, closes near highs, and volume dry-up.

indicators.name: Island Reversal
indicators.description: Detects island reversal patterns (bars stranded between two opposing gaps) and marks the bullish or bearish turn they imply. Trend, volume, and range filters, including an R-squared horizontality test and a volatility bound, restrict detection to the cleanest formations. For traders timing exhaustion turns at trend extremes.

indicators.name: January Effect
indicators.description: Measures the January seasonal on the chart symbol or on its ratio to a benchmark: average January return versus the other months, the January premium in percentage points, and a January barometer hit rate graded against an always-up baseline. January windows are shaded by direction, completed Januaries are labeled, and five alerts track the seasonal calendar.

indicators.name: JMA
indicators.description: The standard published three-stage approximation of Mark Jurik's adaptive moving average with the documented length, phase, and power mapping. The 7-period default line colors itself by slope, a -100 to +100 phase dial repositions the lag-overshoot trade-off, and an optional SMA or EMA overlay of the same length shows how much earlier the JMA turns at real swings.

indicators.name: Jump Detection
indicators.description: Jump Detection standardizes each bar's log return against a robust volatility benchmark - Bipower Variation over a 20-bar lookback by default - and flags one-bar dislocations that clear a 3-sigma threshold. Jump markers, on-chart labels and a variance-decomposition dashboard separate jump risk from ordinary volatility for traders sizing stops and bands.

indicators.name: Kagi
indicators.description: Builds a classic Kagi line from closing prices, turning only after a full reversal amount - ATR-adaptive by default (14-period ATR x1), with percentage and fixed-amount methods. The line draws thick yang once the prior shoulder is exceeded and thin yin once the prior waist breaks, with dashed levels at both, a state dashboard, and four alerts covering flips and reversals.

indicators.name: Kalman Filter
indicators.description: Kalman Filter runs the classic predict-and-update recursion on price, plotting an adaptive estimate whose responsiveness comes from Process Noise (Q, default 0.01) and Measurement Noise (R, default 1) rather than a length. A slope-colored line, price/filter gradient fill and crossing alerts give trend traders a moving-average-style read tuned by noise assumptions.

indicators.name: Kase Studies
indicators.description: Kase Studies unites the Peak Oscillator, KaseCD histogram and DevStops in one build: momentum measured in volatility units across an 8-to-65-bar scan, peak-out thresholds at 2 deviations of the oscillator's own history, and a trailing exit ladder stepped at 1, 2.2 and 3.6 deviations of the two-bar true range. Exhaustion flags and exits from a single framework.

indicators.name: KDE Value Clouds
indicators.description: Maps the statistical distribution of price with kernel density estimation, painting gradient value clouds over accepted zones plus a smooth side profile with its own point of control. Bandwidth adapts automatically via Silverman's rule, replacing arbitrary profile bins. For traders reading balance, inefficiency, and rotation targets statistically.

indicators.name: Keltner Channels
indicators.description: Keltner Channels plot a 20-period EMA centerline with upper and lower bands offset by 2 times the 10-period average true range, producing a volatility-based channel around price. Price pressing against or beyond a band indicates movement that is large relative to recent true range. The build follows the standard modern ATR-based formula with its usual EMA 20, ATR 10, and multiplier 2 defaults.

indicators.name: Kicking Pattern
indicators.description: Detects the kicking pattern: two opposite-colored marubozu, shadows within 15% of range, with the second candle's whole range gapping beyond the first. Each kicker shades the gap between the bodies as the line in the sand, enters on the kick close or a gap retest, invalidates on a close back through the gap, and tracks a 2R target in a results dashboard.

indicators.name: Klinger Oscillator
indicators.description: Calculates a volume force value from price trend direction and volume, then plots the difference between its 34-period and 55-period EMAs as an oscillator, with a 13-period EMA signal line. Crossovers between the oscillator and signal line are the conventional reading. This is the standard implementation of the Klinger Oscillator with its classic 34/55/13 defaults.

indicators.name: kNN Market Architecture
indicators.description: Maps short, medium, and long-term market structure, validating every pivot through a k-nearest-neighbors comparison against historical volatility and volume signatures. Delta Tank labels track order flow at unbroken levels and an anchored volume profile covers the active range. A structure suite for traders who pair levels with participation.

indicators.name: KNN Supertrend Horizon
indicators.description: Filters a Supertrend baseline through a k-nearest-neighbors classifier that checks current RSI and volatility conditions against similar historical bars before confirming direction. Confidence-graded candle coloring, volume-scaled rejection orbs, and a live dashboard complete the read. For trend followers who want fewer, better flips.

indicators.name: Know Sure Thing
indicators.description: Know Sure Thing combines four smoothed rate-of-change readings into a weighted momentum oscillator, plotted with a signal line for crossover reference. Defaults are the classic ROC lengths of 10/15/20/30 smoothed by 10/10/10/15 period SMAs, with a 9-period SMA signal line. This is the standard raw implementation of Pring's KST.

indicators.name: Laguerre Filter
indicators.description: Laguerre Filter plots John Ehlers' four-stage cascade as a slope-colored trend line on price, its behavior set by a single Gamma damping factor (default 0.8) rather than a bar-count length. A price/filter gradient fill plus crossing and slope-turn alerts make it a drop-in trend baseline for crossover and pullback traders.

indicators.name: Laguerre RSI
indicators.description: Laguerre RSI compresses Ehlers' four-stage filter cascade into a 0-to-1 oscillator with Gamma (default 0.5) as its only knob and decision levels at 0.8 and 0.2. Because it pins near the extremes during persistent moves, the actionable events are the threshold exits - and built-in alerts cover all four crossings for trend-holding momentum traders.

indicators.name: Lead-lag Detection
indicators.description: Sweeps the cross-correlation of two instruments' returns across lags of -20 to +20 bars over a rolling 100-observation window - SP:SPX as the default comparison - and plots the peak with 2/sqrt(n) significance bounds. A profile beside the last bar draws the full correlation function lag by lag, a dashboard names the leader, and alerts cover new leads, leader flips, lost relationships and peak-lag shifts.

indicators.name: Lead-lag Instrument Triggers
indicators.description: Executes on the chart only after a related leader instrument moves first: breakouts, failures at key levels and 2-sigma momentum thrusts on the leader (BTCUSDT by default) arm a 10-bar trigger window, and the chart confirms by breaking its own 20-bar extreme. A 0.3 minimum-correlation gate re-validates the pair, with catch-up setups, non-confirmation signals and eight alerts.

indicators.name: Level Freshness & Decay
indicators.description: Level Freshness & Decay tracks every swing-born support and resistance level through a fresh-tested-spent lifecycle, scoring each from 100% and spending 30% per touch with optional touch-quality grading and a 500-bar time half-life. Lines fade as scores decay, so the chart itself shows which levels still hold unspent interest and which are near retirement.

indicators.name: Line Break
indicators.description: Builds a three-line break chart from confirmed closes - chart timeframe by default, any higher timeframe optional - and draws it beside the last bar while stepped plots track the active line across chart time. Continuation and reversal trigger prices plot on the price chart and feed a dashboard, with alerts for new lines, turnarounds and 8-line extended runs.

indicators.name: Linear Regression
indicators.description: Linear Regression fits a least-squares regression to price over a 100-bar lookback and plots the result according to a mode input: a regression curve (default), the slope value, or a channel around the fitted line with bands at plus and minus two standard deviations. It shows where price sits relative to its statistical trend over the window. The calculation is the standard least-squares method with no proprietary adjustments.

indicators.name: Linear Regression Fan
indicators.description: Fits a least-squares linear regression over a chosen window and fans equidistant lines around it, spaced by root-mean-square deviation times an adjustable multiplier. The rays serve as sloped support and resistance, with extremity breaks suited to measured-move targeting. A compact framework for traders working graded trend levels.

indicators.name: Linear Regression Histogram
indicators.description: The Linear Regression Histogram counts how often price lands in each bin of a linear regression channel, turning trend data into a frequency map. Bins that price keeps revisiting are highlighted in blue as zones of interest, giving trend traders statistically grounded support and resistance that travels with the slope instead of sitting flat.

indicators.name: Liquidation Estimates (Real-Time)
indicators.description: Liquidation Estimates (Real-Time) approximates long and short liquidations bar by bar on any timeframe, inferring them from volume and price behavior where exchange records are unavailable. Color-coded bars plus dominance, total, and cumulative views show which side of the leveraged market is being flushed: a sentiment and reversal gauge for derivatives traders.

indicators.name: Liquidation Levels
indicators.description: Liquidation Levels projects the prices where clusters of highly leveraged longs and shorts would be forced out, marking each detection with a significance-sized bubble and zone lines for 100x, 50x, and 25x tiers. Because price is often drawn toward these zones, the levels double as targets, stop-placement guides, and early volatility warnings.

indicators.name: Liquidations Meter
indicators.description: The Liquidations Meter grades each bar's momentum by estimating the leverage tiers of longs and shorts liquidated within it, separating bull from bear pressure and hinting at exhaustion when even low-leverage positions get hit. A built-in calculator projects exact liquidation prices for any entry and leverage, backed by a bar-statistics dashboard.

indicators.name: Liquidity Delta Profiler
indicators.description: The Liquidity Delta Profiler plots buy-side and sell-side liquidity zones from swing pivots, then splits each zone into four slices colored by volume delta to show who was aggressive inside. Sweep-reversal signals for absorption, exhaustion, divergence, and rejection (plus zone-health decay and a win-tracking dashboard) complete the toolkit.

indicators.name: Liquidity Heatmap LTF
indicators.description: Liquidity Heatmap LTF highlights the candle bodies that carried the most volume on a lower timeframe you select, painting them as column heatmaps on your working chart. The result is a fast, selective map of where trading activity concentrated (likely support and resistance) without you having to drop down a timeframe yourself.

indicators.name: Liquidity Levels
indicators.description: Liquidity Levels turns volume peaks into support and resistance, stamping a level at every price where unusual activity fired. A companion histogram counts the closes that fell between neighboring levels, and how many were bullish, adding an acceptance-and-volatility read that plain horizontal lines cannot give.

indicators.name: Liquidity Levels/Voids (VP)
indicators.description: Liquidity Levels/Voids (VP) evaluates traded volume between two swing points to expose both sides of the liquidity map: levels born at swing highs and lows, and voids where price jumped through on minimal volume.
